newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine bomber plane crashes into house, 5 hurt.
newsitem.headline: Philippine bomber plane crashes into house, 5 hurt.

text.p: Five people were injured when a Philippine Air Force plane used in bombing operations against rebels crashed into a house in southern Davao city on Monday and demolished it, police said.

A mother and her two children occupying the house in Toril district suffered burns while the two pilots of the OV-10 Bronco attack aircraft sustained minor injuries after parachuting out of their plane, police sergeant Rogelio Maagma said.

The plane was on a maintenance flight when it developed engine trouble, an Air Force statement. It was one of several aircraft used in attacks on guerrilla groups in the southern islands, an air force officer said.
The plane burst into flames as it slammed into the house, Maagma said by telephone.
"Nothing was left of the house," he said.
